title: Dynamic Temperature Monitor
description: An environmental monitoring station receives a continuous stream of temperature readings throughout the day. Implement a system that processes these readings one by one and efficiently reports the median temperature observed so far after each new reading.
constraints: Incoming temperature values are integers between -100,000 and 100,000.
At least one temperature will be added before querying the median.
Total number of added temperatures will not exceed 50,000.
input_format: A sequence of operations: 'add(val)' to insert a temperature and 'findMedian()' to retrieve the current median.
output_format: For each 'findMedian()' operation, return the floating-point median value.

examples.explanation: After adding 1 and 2, the sorted stream is [1, 2]. The median is (1 + 2) / 2 = 1.5.
After adding 3, the sorted stream is [1, 2, 3]. The median is the middle element, 2.0.
After adding 5, the sorted stream is [1, 2, 3, 5]. The median is (2 + 3) / 2 = 2.5.
